description: AI Enablement Dashboard - authorization scopes and role templates

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.DashboardViewer
scopes.description: View AI initiative adoption dashboard (masked user details)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.DashboardUserDetail
scopes.description: View unmasked names and emails of enabled/active users

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.DashboardAdmin
scopes.description: Trigger manual sync jobs across all initiatives

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.JobScheduler
scopes.description: Granted to the Job Scheduling service instance only, so it can call the sync jobs

role-templates.name: DashboardUserDetail
role-templates.description: Dashboard viewer - real, unmasked user data

role-templates.name: DashboardAdmin
role-templates.description: Can trigger sync jobs, plus full viewing rights

role-collections.name: AI Dashboard Viewer
role-collections.description: View AI initiatives - masked user data

role-collections.name: AI Dashboard User Detail
role-collections.description: View AI initiatives - unmasked user data

role-collections.name: AI Dashboard Admin
role-collections.description: Full access including sync job triggers
